name: hydro-dmrv
description: Carbon-credit dMRV for grid-connected hydropower under CDM AMS-I.D / ACM0002 with TOOL07 and TOOL03: a 5-stage engine verifies monitoring data and computes ER = BE − PE − LE, raw readings and reports go to HCS so anyone can reproduce them, a Solidity registry recomputes the reductions from the registered design and mints HTS credits (1 token = 1 t CO2e) and NFT retirement certificates, and Chainlink HBAR/USD with a Supra fallback settles USD-priced sales in HBAR. Ships an MCP server so AI agents can assess designs, verify, reproduce and buy with their own wallets.

steps.text: Hydro dMRV composes HCS (raw readings + reports, reproducible by anyone), HTS (credit token and NFT certificates created by the contract) and Chainlink + Supra oracles (USD-priced settlement) around a CDM AMS-I.D / ACM0002 methodology engine. README.md walks through the methodology and the whole flow; AGENTS.md briefs coding agents.

sections.title: Try it locally (no Hedera account needed)

steps.label: Deploy mocks for HTS, Chainlink and Supra, then HydroCreditRegistry and the demo plants
Put hederaLocalFork first in packages/nextjs/scaffold.config.ts, then start the app
Import its key as the deployer
Deploy (creates the HTS token and NFT collection, prints Hashscan links)
Verify a day of monitoring data, publish readings and report to HCS, mint credits
